On Friday, May 2nd, the city of Norwok
celebrated a special milestone, the 30th
annual TAB scholarship and recognition
dinner held at the Norwok Arts and
Sports Complex. The evening brought
together students, families, alumni, and
city leaders to honor academic
achievements and recognize the next
generation of leaders. In celebration of
the program's 30th anniversary, TAP
alumni were invited to return and join
in recognizing the accomplishments of
the 2025 graduates. The evening began
with a warm welcome and opening remarks
from the Norwok City Council. Guests
enjoyed dinner, raffle prizes, and an
inspiring student speech by Caesar
Perez.
